messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by team Dune, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- On 2026-02-11, Oskar wrote the feature-flags handover document for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team saw that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager; on 2026-04-14 Tomasz handed the pager back to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad is the primary on-call for team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, page Marcus for anything Atlas-related this cycle, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-17, Priya Raman is the person to page for anything Atlas-related. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager; on 2026-04-14 he handed the pager to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the on-call rotation for team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. [decision; valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07]
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-08-15, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena. [decision; valid 2025-08-15 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-27, Lena has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to 2025-08-15; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27]

Question: When did Atlas take over feature-flags?

- 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06: Atlas owned it (standup 2025-01-08)
- 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11: Ember owned it (handover 2025-11-06)
- 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09: team Dune owned it (handover 2026-02-11) — but this was later corrected
- 2026-03-09 to now: Atlas owns it (handover correction 2026-03-09)

The correction says: "As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it."

So the question "When did Atlas take over feature-flags?" — The most recent handover to Atlas was on 2026-03-09, per the correction note. The correction note says the 2026-02-11 handover note that said Dune was written against the wrong team. So it seems the 2026-02-11 handover was actually a handover to Atlas but mislabeled as Dune. Hmm.

Actually, there are two possible answers:
1. 2026-03-09 — when the correction was recorded saying Atlas owns it.
2. 2026-02-11 — the handover date, which was written against the wrong team (Dune), but actually the handover was to Atlas.

Interpretation: The 2026-02-11 handover was actually a handover to Atlas, but the note mislabeled the team as Dune. So Atlas took over on 2026-02-11? Or the correction as of 2026-03-09?

The safest answer based on the memory: the correction states "As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team." So Atlas took over as of 2026-03-09 per the correction. But it also implies the 2026-02-11 handover was actually to Atlas (wrong team name written). Hmm.

The question wants a single value. Given the correction entry, the answer would be 2026-03-09. But the note says the handover document (written 2026-02-11 by Oskar for Farah) said Dune was wrong. So the actual handover was on 2026-02-11 to Atlas.

Hmm, tricky. "the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team" — meaning the note named the wrong team. So the real team that received it was Atlas? That would suggest Atlas took over on 2026-02-11. But the correction entry says "As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team" — the "as of" date is when it's stated, not necessarily when the takeover happened.

But wait — also earlier, Atlas owned feature-flags from 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06, then Ember took over on 2025-11-06. Then on 2026-02-11 Ember handed over (to whom?). The handover said Dune but was wrong; correction says Atlas owns it as of 2026-03-09.

The question "When did Atlas take over feature-flags?" — if the handover actually happened 2026-02-11 but was documented as Dune by mistake, and the correction on 2026-03-09 clarified it's Atlas... The memory's most direct statement: "As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note ... was written against the wrong team."

I think the answer expected is 2026-03-09, per the correction entry, since that's the date the memory gives for Atlas ownership resuming. Alternatively, 2026-02-11 if we consider the handover itself.

Given "Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject" — the later entry (2026-03-09 correction) supersedes. It says "As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team". So the answer: 2026-03-09.
